summary: Children are guaranteed half of the estate with one child and two thirds with two or more, which a will cannot reduce. A foreign national resident can choose the law of their nationality under the EU Succession Regulation. Bulgaria has no trust law; foundations exist but only for non-profit purposes.
reserved_share: Children: 1/2 of the estate with one child, 2/3 with two or more; spouse and parents also protected; Law on Inheritance (Закон за наследството) arts. 28-30. Fractions for spouse and parents not confirmed.
foreign_law_note: Regulation 650/2012 art. 22 lets a person choose the law of their nationality; the reserved share of the chosen law then applies, not the Bulgarian one.
trust_note: No trust law; no treaty recognition. Foundations exist under the Non-Profit Legal Entities Act 2000 for public or restricted private-benefit purposes, so a family foundation is heavily restricted.
open_questions: Reserved share of spouse and parents (Law on Inheritance art. 28 and following).
How far a foundation can serve a family under the Non-Profit Legal Entities Act.
